# David Z. Chen

> Software, side projects, and writing by David Z. Chen.

Canonical HTML URLs are the sources for citations. Markdown copies are generated from published HTML. Field Notes is a dated public journal; its interactive account collection is not included in this text index.

## Website and writing

- [David Z. Chen · Software & side projects](https://davidzlchen.com/index.md): A little corner of the internet for David Z. Chen’s software, side projects, and interests. Explore JustSkiing, SkiGuessr, and Pokémon Sleep Field Notes.
- [Blog · David Z. Chen](https://davidzlchen.com/blog/index.md): Notes on building useful tools, little games, and personal projects.
- [How I built Pokémon Sleep Field Notes with Codex · David Z. Chen](https://davidzlchen.com/blog/pokemon-sleep-repository/index.md): How I built Pokémon Sleep Field Notes with Codex: a personal research journal for island milestones, investment decisions, and progress over time.
- [David’s Pokémon Sleep Field Notes](https://davidzlchen.com/pokemon-sleep/index.md): David’s Pokémon Sleep Field Notes: island milestones, researcher rank, familiar helpers, and supplies for the next good night.
- [Pokémon Sleep Production Analyzer · Field Notes](https://davidzlchen.com/pokemon-sleep/analyzer/index.md): Estimate daily berries, ingredients, skill triggers, Snorlax strength, and Dream Shards for Pokémon Sleep. Start with a saved helper or explore a custom build, nature, and subskills.
- [Privacy — David Z. Chen](https://davidzlchen.com/privacy/index.md): Optional analytics and browser storage on David Z. Chen’s website and Pokémon Sleep Field Notes.
